implementation.md:359 asks for literal JSON replies; the 0.19 fixtures express some replies as templates ('gen' log generator, 'repeat' data). A TypeScript harness needs either the same expansion rule or exported literal replies. Proposed supplement P-V2-10: publish the expanded replies as data.
The sink event grammar (types and arities) is implicit in browser.md:117-130. Proposed supplement P-V2-9 = the closed grammar of tools/sink_checker_strict.py.
